    p = []
    for i in range(n):
        if i == 0:
            # Choose the first element arbitrarily
            p.append(a[i])

            # Choose an element different from the previous one and the next one
            if p[-1] != b[i]:
                p.append(b[i])
            elif p[-1] != c[i]:
